title: Apologizing to a Younger Sibling
paragraphs: After snapping angrily at his younger brother over a minor mistake that was not entirely his fault, Idris felt an immediate wave of guilt once he saw how hurt his brother looked.

Rather than letting the tension linger unspoken, as their family often did with small conflicts, Idris found his brother later that evening and apologized directly, admitting his reaction had been unfair.
His brother seemed surprised, mentioning that older siblings rarely apologized so directly in their family, usually letting arguments simply fade away without acknowledgment on either side.
Their relationship noticeably warmed after that conversation, and Idris realized that a sincere apology, even for something small, often repaired more than silence ever could.
